headline: Getting help to Nepal's flood survivors is proving difficult
context: Blocked roads and monsoon weather are complicating efforts to get food, shelter and emergency hygeine to survivors of Nepal's catastrophic floods. World Vision's Dhruba Gurmachhan explains what survivors need the most.

sources.name: NPR
